node.statement: Under the cross-product identification used to define Delta in lem-stage1-exterior-cohomology, functoriality of pullback and the diagonal formula for cup product give ell^*(a)=m_A((sigma^* tensor id)Delta(a)). Substituting the external expansion Delta(a)=a tensor 1+1 tensor a+sum_j aPrime_j tensor aDoublePrime_j yields ell^*(a)=sigma^*(a)+a+sum_j sigma^*(aPrime_j)aDoublePrime_j. Together with the preceding vanishing, this is the asserted identity.
